race.comment: WEEKDAY FLYER (11) put the writing on the wall last start when she made a long, sustained run to get up for third over 1300m at the Grange circuit. Gets in with 2kgs less under today's scale and the extra 100m is a big help. Finds the perfect race at this stage of the campaign. Consistent mare GLAMOUR MAGIC (3) settled midfield then came home powerfully to edge WEEKDAY FLYER out of second last time out over 1300m at the Grange track. In the money at four of six runs. Should appreciate the extra trip today and is sure to prove tough to hold out. MY STAR (8) came off a 38-day break when a moderate fourth over 1200m here last time. In the frame twice from four runs here at 1400m. Should give a good account. NEFERUSOBEK (9) can improve coming back in distance off a five-week let-up.
